report:
Adversarial plan-check of the 9-slice hub-sdk-25-switch-account-invites set. VERDICT: PASS - sound enough to execute; concerns are minor/bounded, no blocking gap.

CHECK 1 (coverage): PASS. Trocar conta covered in all three surfaces (03 account menu, 04 entitlement/402 panel, 05 no-role) plus the 02 seam. Seller invite covered end-to-end: 06 schema, 07 client seam + code->response mapper, 08 server create/list/resend/revoke, 09 UI state + resend/revoke + warnings/errors by code. No feature left homeless.

CHECK 2 (acceptance testable): MOSTLY PASS. All acceptances are concrete except slice 08's 'GET / list reflects invitation state (either persisted status or reconciled from fake.list)' - the either/or is an undecided design choice, not a testable criterion (see C2).

CHECK 3 (depends_on): PASS. 03/04/05 -> only 02 (correct). 08 -> 06 AND 07 (correct). 09 -> 08 (correct). 01 is a transitive prerequisite of all. Minor: 06 declaring depends_on 01 is not strictly minimal - the schema/migration/web-type touch nothing from the SDK bump - but it is harmless/conservative (C5).

CHECK 4 (same-wave file disjointness): PASS. Wave 2 (02 web-auth / 06 db+web-types / 07 api-sellers) disjoint. Wave 3 (03 SalesOpsApp / 04 MissingEntitlementPanel / 05 NoRolePage+i18n / 08 admin-service+routes) disjoint. i18n pt-BR.json/en.json touched by 05 (wave 3) and 09 (wave 4) = CROSS-wave, sequential, OK. api-client.ts only in 09; admin/types.ts only in 06; each single-owner. The 02 guard test scans apps/api/src + apps/web/src read-only, no write conflict. No same-wave collision found.

CHECK 5 (hidden design decisions): switchAccount navigate-vs-in-page is adequately bounded - deferred to slice-01's sdk-2.5.0-surface.md with an explicit default (navigates like login, no queryClient.clear). CONCERNS: (C2) invitation_status reconciliation is genuinely undecided - persisted status only ever becomes 'pending' (create) or 'revoked' (revoke); 'accepted'/'expired' can arrive only from Hub list(), yet slice 09 renders all four states from the persisted SellerRow. Unless slice 08's list route reconciles+persists accepted/expired, those states never surface. Pin this across 06/08/09. (C3) revoke REST verb unpinned: 08 says 'POST /:id/revoke (or DELETE, match repo style)' but 09 hardcodes POST /revoke - if 08 picks DELETE, 09 mismatches. (C4) 'locale' is passed by 07/08 but its source in the route (header? default?) is unspecified.

CHECK 6 (spec proof items): PASS. no organizationId in body (08), accessToken from Authorization header not body/hubAuth (08), invite failure never rolls back seller (08), acceptUrl never logged (07/08/09), no-hand-built-prompt guard test (02), SDK pinned exact no caret (01), do-not-install hub-sdk-testing (01/02). Verified: auth-model.md:127 already records hub-sdk-testing is in no package.json/lockfile, consistent with the rule.

CHECK 7 (migration safety): PASS. 0025 additive nullable text columns (invitation_id/invitation_status/invited_org_id), follows 0024 (confirmed high-water), no RLS/org_id added to sellers, invited_org_id is informational, meta journal+snapshot updated. Safe.

ADDITIONAL CONCERNS: (C1, medium) Slice 01 files_modified lists only 5 files, but its step-3 grep for '2.3.0' will hit many tracked files. Most of those hits are NARRATIVE history ('2.3.0 grew/owns X' in auth-provider.ts, app-auth.ts, app-auth-bff-*.test.ts, milestones) that must NOT be rewritten to 2.5.0 - only the actual PIN strings change. Step wording scopes to 'expected pin' but gives no explicit warning against corrupting historical comments; a naive bulk edit would corrupt accurate history and could pull unlisted test files into wave 1. (C8, minor) No dedicated SDK-pin guard test asserting the literal '2.3.0' appears to exist (git grep hits are narrative), so slice 01's named oracle risks being vacuous; slice 01 hedges to env-example-contract + type-check, which is acceptable. (C6, minor) The documented stance reversal ('invitation delivery lives in Hub operator workflows') is assigned only to a Capture-phase ADR; no slice updates the knowledge/reference file holding the old stance. (C7-note) The entire error/warning contract (HubInvitationError codes/fields, warning strings application_url_missing/email_not_configured/email_failed) rests on slice-01's surface note being accurate - single point of truth, which is by design.

None of C1-C8 blocks execution. Recommend the executor: pin the revoke verb (C3) and the list reconciliation semantics (C2) before/at slice 08, and add an explicit 'do not rewrite historical 2.3.0 narrative' note to slice 01 (C1).
summary: PASS - plan-set is executable; waves file-disjoint, deps correct, full coverage. Non-blocking concerns: undecided invitation_status reconciliation (06/08/09), unpinned revoke verb (08 vs 09), and slice-01 risk of rewriting narrative 2.3.0 comments.
